description: Phase 3D. Exercises the psiphon-family activation lifecycle. Day 1 enables the experimental-families gate so psiphon routes are selectable. Day 3 drives a soak-only psiphon route activation; WAVE 5 CORRECTION: this no longer measures anything. `psiphon_compiled_in` is now constant false and `RecordPsiphonActiveRoute` REFUSES a non-empty route ID, because psiphon-tunnel-core has never been in `core/go.mod` and psiphon is a third party's network a publisher cannot host at all. The activation steps below now record a refusal; the scenario is retained only so the no-leak invariants keep running against a real diagnostics blob. Retiring it is rig-lane work. Day 7 simulates a publisher-bundle rotation by clearing the active psiphon route; diagnostics MUST clear `psiphon_active_route` to empty within the same day. Day 14 exercises the locked invariant: psiphon is NOT opportunistic — auto-promotion MUST NOT promote a network whose only family is psiphon. The legacy subscription-url block layers so the distribution-failure invariants continue to assert.
